levels.surface: المظفر بن جعفر بن المظفر العلوي السمرقندي

notes: «جميعا قالا» makes جعفر and حيدر co-transmitters of one level (rule 2). The archive flag about «و» between two names is handled by that level.
«أبي عبد الله» is an Imam written inside the chain after «عن»: narrator (owner ruling 2). The saying «إن للقائم منا غيبة» follows his name.
«أبيه» is bare, so relation. «رضي الله عنه» and «ع» are stripped; the vocalised text is read without its marks.
